items.title: Neale Daniher, former AFL player and motor neurone disease campaigner, dies aged 65
items.description: Former Essendon player and Demons coach Neale Daniher has died, aged 65. He was diagnosed with motor neurone disease in 2013 and campaigned to raise awareness of the disease and increase research.

items.title: Live: Paul Brereton resigns from National Anti-Corruption Commission
items.description: National Anti-Corruption Commission chief Paul Brereton has resigned, three years into his term. Follow live.

items.title: Government bails out Rex's multi-million-dollar debt to regional airports
items.description: Council-owned airports have been bailed out by the federal government to the tune of $4.8 million, $2 million of which was for NSW alone.

items.title: Dezi Freeman goaded officers to 'come and get me' before fatal shooting
items.description: The Coroners Court has heard about Dezi Freeman's final moments before a fatal confrontation at his hideout in Victoria's north-east.

items.title: Trump says a deal is close. Here are the sticking points still dividing the US and Iran
items.description: A possible US-Iran agreement is taking shape, but the toughest issues are still unsettled, including reopening the Strait of Hormuz, curbing Tehran's nuclear ambitions, and ending regional fighting.

items.title: 'I thought the plane was going down': 10 injured on Cathay Pacific flight
items.description: An Australian passenger aboard a flight from Brisbane to Hong Kong says he thought he was going to die after the aircraft suddenly plunged mid-air.

items.title: V'landys to take over as NRL CEO after Abdo quits to join Tennis Australia
items.description: NRL CEO Andrew Abdo causes a shock in the rugby league world by departing mid-season after a highly-successful six-year stint.

items.title: Magnussen flops at Enhanced Games, finishes last twice
items.description: James Magnussen, wearing a garish golden suit, has finished dead last at the inaugural Enhanced Games event.

items.title: 'Surprise attack' left 11 shot within seconds of Bondi massacre starting
items.description: The Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion has entered a critical phase, assessing the circumstances surrounding the Bondi terror attack with ASIO director-general Mike Burgess defended counter-terrorism resourcing

items.title: Breaking: Man, 23, charged with murder over death of eight-week-old baby
items.description: A 23-year-old man has been charged with murder over the death of an eight-week-old child in suburban Perth.

items.title: Victim of fatal Queensland shark attack identified
items.description: While the Far North Queensland community is reeling from the death of local spearfisher Michael Jensz, experts warn human-shark interactions are increasing.

items.title: China launches astronauts into space amid new race to Moon
items.description: China has launched three astronauts into space, including one who will stay for a year for a study of the long-term impacts on a human in orbit, ahead of Beijing's goal of a crewed Moon landing by 2030.

items.title: How a container of hot chocolate put the spotlight on airport security
items.description: A security scare that shut down a Victorian airport last week was found to be a false alarm.

items.title: Man jailed for fatally amputating man's foot using circular saw
items.description: Kalman Tal's loved ones have told of their distress at how the 66-year-old's leg was amputated in a public park. Farm worker John Yalu has today been sentenced for manslaughter.

items.title: These mince recipes require minimal effort for maximum flavour
items.description: Mix up your mince menu with these versatile and affordable meals for the whole family.

items.title: Death of 'drongo': Are Aussie insults and swearwords dying out?
items.description: Classic Australian swearwords and insults are becoming less popular with younger generations. What does losing them mean for our culture?

items.title: A movie about mystery-hunting sheep delights this May
items.description: Plus the rom-com of yore returns in Finding Emily, the farmyard mystery that's been delighting audiences, and a gory Hollywood video game adaptation filmed on the Gold Coast.

items.title: Dog-friendly cafe issued warning after customer complaint
items.description: Kellie Hunter opened her cafe in the Adelaide Hills in 2023 as a friendly place for dogs and their owners, but the local council has now put a stop to it after one complaint.

items.title: Notorious Perth paedophile Bradley Pen Dragon released from jail again
items.description: A notorious Perth paedophile who breached his prison release conditions 11 times has again been freed into the community, as the child protection minister argues it may be unconstitutional to keep him in custody.

items.title: Push for law change that could keep Baden-Clay behind bars for longer
items.description: The possible release of wife killer Gerard Baden-Clay next year could be pushed back by up to a decade under proposed changes to Queensland's parole laws.

items.title: Aboriginal community workers say diphtheria response 'heartbreaking'
items.description: Residents and service providers in the remote community of Yuendumu, where there are reports of dozens of diphtheria cases, say the NT government has not done enough to keep people safe.

items.title: 'I did it': Parramatta council official fronts corruption watchdog
items.description: During her third day on the witness stand, Roxanne Thornton told the Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC) she was responsible for hiring processes that were "extremely flawed".

items.title: Australia's opening times are world leading and researchers say it's a strength
items.description: Australia has a "distinctive strength" when it comes to early trading, but more knowledge is needed for businesses to fully capitalise on it.

items.title: Committee rejects calls to review greyhound phase-out bill
items.description: A parliamentary committee has rejected a request to review a bill which would phase out Tasmania's greyhound racing industry. It follows new data which shows 19 ex-racing greyhounds have died in Tasmania this year.

items.title: Surfing event in NZ issued 'code red' after animal attacks photographer
items.description: The New Zealand Pro World Surf League is put on hold after what is believed to be a seal attacked a photographer.
